fact: In October 2024 the Government of Equatorial Guinea told the UNHCR Executive Committee it is working on a new law on Forced Displacements and a Management Centre for Forced Displacements, both to be operational by early 2026.
title: 75th Session of the UNHCR Executive Council
publisher: UNHCR / Government of Equatorial Guinea (statement by Ilan Weitzman)
